messages.english: Plan seed sourcing for field cycles without nursery raising.
messages.translation: Pulanyani u wanala ha mbeu ya maitele a masimu a si na tshifhinga tsha tshitiratshi tsha zwo simiwaho.
Tolani thodea dza mbeu ya masimu

messages.english: Crop planner → Saved planned nursery batches → Field seed sourcing
messages.translation: Mupulani wa zwo simiwaho → Zwiteṅwa zwa tshitiratshi zwo pulanywaho zwo vhulungwaho → U wanala ha mbeu ya masimu

messages.english: Open the separate field worksheet for accepted cycles without a nursery phase. Declare botanical seeds, confirm your gross whole-seed requirement, group cycles that can share a supply, and enter your allocation and pack size. Blank counts stay unknown. This temporary worksheet does not record stock, place orders or save the plan.
messages.translation: Vulani bammbiri la mushumo lo fhambanaho la masimu la maitele o tanganedzwaho a si na tshifhinga tsha tshitiratshi tsha zwo simiwaho. Divhadzani mbeu dza zwo simiwaho, khwathisedzani thodea yavho yothe ya mbeu dzo fhelelaho, vhumbani zwigwada zwa maitele a no nga kovhelana thodea, nahone ni dzhenise mukovhe wavho na saizi ya phakhethe. Zwivhalo zwi si na tshithu zwi dzula zwi sa diwi. Bammbiri ili la mushumo la tshifhinganyana a li rekhodi zwitoko, a li vhei odara kana u vhulunga pulane.
